findings.text: blocking: two of the three peak criteria the done_when names still fail on the prepared home - doubling the store's delivered-run rows raises the head's forty-entry peak 17.1 % and doubling the plan documents raises it 15.7 %, both against the under-10 % the section allows - so the node's measure is not met and it cannot land as satisfying section 14; only the eight-entry ratio (0.496) and the row-decode test hold.

non-blocking: _remember_history_index and its _HISTORY_READ_ENTRIES constant duplicate the capability of reckon/file_memo.py:584 BoundedMap, a bounded least-recently-used map the repository already owns and already uses at reckon/run_store.py:1117 and reckon/ledger.py:1770; the addition should wrap or use file_memo.bounded_map rather than add a second bounded cache with its own eviction rule and its own reset path in _reset_caches.

non-blocking: the non-empty history_plans narrowing branch (the per-plan _store_history_rows loop and its missing-plan ledger fallback) has no test that exercises it - no test passes history_plans or sets a non-empty roadmap_history_scope - so a regression in that read would redden nothing.

non-blocking: the after_suite gate log carries a bare 'revision:' first line and a closing EXIT=0, but no literal command and no tree line, so the done_when's requirement that each arm's log carry its literal command is unmet for this arm; the command survives only in the manifest's after_suite JSON.

non-blocking: baseline_suite.result_line quotes '58 passed in 147.62s', but the cited baseline_suite-repair.log summarises '58 passed in 39.47s' and no on-disk log carries 147.62s as a result line, so a metric the record quotes cannot be reconciled with the log it cites.
